flowing_strikes.name: Flowing Strikes
flowing_strikes.description: Once per combat: chain together a flurry of strikes, greatly increasing your Speed and damage for a few turns.

opening_strike.name: Opening Strike
opening_strike.description: Once per combat: a precise opening blow that leaves the enemy exposed to increased damage for a few turns.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Once per combat: slam your shield into the enemy, shattering their defenses and exposing them to all damage types.

bulwark_stance.name: Bulwark Stance
bulwark_stance.description: Once per combat, for the rest of the fight: brace behind your shield, drastically reducing damage taken.

arcane_detonation.name: Arcane Detonation
arcane_detonation.description: Once per combat: channel the sigil's stored power into a devastating burst of damage against one enemy.

hexbreaker.name: Hexbreaker
hexbreaker.description: Once per combat: overload the sigil, weakening the target's next attacks significantly.

wardstone.name: Wardstone
wardstone.description: Once per combat: the sigil erects a protective ward, shielding you for a portion of your maximum health.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: Once per combat: call upon the sigil's wardings to regenerate a portion of your health each turn for several turns.

titans_fury.name: Titan's Fury
titans_fury.description: Once per combat: heave your weapon with earth-shaking force, greatly increasing your damage for a few turns.

executioners_verdict.name: Executioner's Verdict
executioners_verdict.description: Once per combat: a finishing blow that leaves the enemy exposed to overwhelming force.

third_eye.name: Third Eye
third_eye.description: Once per combat: pierce the enemy's mind, laying their defenses bare.

unbroken_will.name: Unbroken Will
unbroken_will.description: Once per combat, for the rest of the fight: steel your mind against pain, reducing damage taken.

second_heart.name: Second Heart
second_heart.description: Once per combat: awaken a second heartbeat, regenerating your health each turn for several turns.

martyrs_resolve.name: Martyr's Resolve
martyrs_resolve.description: Once per combat: steel your chest against the killing blow, shielding yourself for a portion of your maximum health.

relentless_charge.name: Relentless Charge
relentless_charge.description: Once per combat: surge forward with relentless momentum, gaining a burst of Speed and damage for a few turns.

crippling_stride.name: Crippling Stride
crippling_stride.description: Once per combat: a decisive step that throws the enemy off balance, weakening their next attacks.

windrunners_gait.name: Windrunner's Gait
windrunners_gait.description: Once per combat, for the rest of the fight: move with impossible speed.

severing_kick.name: Severing Kick
severing_kick.description: Once per combat: a searing kick that cracks the enemy's elemental wards.

bloodpact_surge.name: Bloodpact Surge
bloodpact_surge.description: Once per combat: channel a pact of blood, marking the enemy for greater harm.

veins_of_vigor.name: Veins of Vigor
veins_of_vigor.description: Once per combat: quicken your blood, regenerating your health each turn for several turns.

soul_anchor.name: Soul Anchor
soul_anchor.description: Once per combat: anchor your very soul, shielding you against annihilation.

apotheosis_echo.name: Apotheosis Echo
apotheosis_echo.description: Once per combat, for the rest of the fight: channel a fragment of apotheosis, empowering your strikes.
